Metadata.title: Toolkit
Metadata.description: A curated collection of developer tools to boost your productivity. From formatters to generators, everything you need in one place.

Home.heroDescription: A curated collection of developer tools to boost your productivity. From formatters to generators, everything you need in one place.
Home.featuresDescription: This project is an experiment to see how we can build a modern toolkit app with Next.js 15 and shadcn/ui.
Home.footer: Built by <author>kiyocy24</author>. The source code is available on <github>GitHub</github>.

ToolsLayout.title: Developer Tools
ToolsLayout.description: Simple and efficient tools for your daily development tasks.

Docs.title: Introduction
Docs.paragraph1: These are just tools I personally wanted, built for my own use. They are mainly intended for engineers.
Docs.paragraph2: All computations run on the client side. Depending on how you use them, they may put a heavy load on your device, so please be careful.
Docs.paragraph3: No guarantees are made about how these tools behave. Use them at your own risk.
